guarantees: Pinned v1.21.3 manifest creates all 47 resources; all four OCI references carry verified index digests.
Installation uses a 256 KiB request and 32 MiB total response budget; normal requests remain limited to 64 KiB.
Installation waits on Deployments without repeatedly downloading large CRD schemas.
TLS child creation is durably reserved before Certificate admission and requires trusted Certificate and cert-manager child metadata before its first UID receipt.
ACME account private keys are created once and preserved across retries; TLS keys and returned certificate chains are validated without exposing material.
Lost create and delete receipts recover by exact nonce, UID and resourceVersion; explicit reconcile is required for known missing resources.
Same-name replacements and configuration drift stop mutations; shared Issuers and account Secrets survive domain removal.
Observations do not write to Kubernetes; failed ACME diagnostics follow bounded current owner chains.
Local test certificates are marked local_test; production certificates require an independently verified built-in ISRG root chain.
limits: These are real TLS/HTTP protocol fixtures with synthetic Kubernetes resources, not a claim of publicly reachable DNS or publicly trusted ACME issuance.
Real K3s/Pebble HTTP-01, renewal, domain deletion and cross-cluster probes are reported separately by the main S4 acceptance run.
